content_source_linkage.policy: source_id stays NULL for bulk evidence rows, matching existing production rows; content_sources rows are per-article seeds, not per-site.

id_compatibility.resolution: The dataset id is carried in snapshot metadata only; the DB primary key is server-generated. Dataset ids remain the stable local identity for review tooling.

rls_and_permissions.write_path: service_role (bypasses RLS) or admin-authenticated session ('admins manage sources/snapshots' policy)
rls_and_permissions.anon: SELECT grant only; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE denied by grant and by RLS policies
rls_and_permissions.read_path: anon reads only documents/snapshots cited by APPROVED knowledge claims (policy-enforced)
rls_and_permissions.verified_from: committed migrations 20261003211635 (grants/policies, RLS enabled lines 175-176) + live REST probe (anon GET ok, anon GET on research_findings/content_drafts -> 401/42501)

triggers_and_publication_gates.source_documents: NO triggers (no updated_at, no audit, no gate) and NO realtime/publication membership
triggers_and_publication_gates.source_snapshots: NO triggers and NO realtime/publication membership
triggers_and_publication_gates.content_sources: has updated_at trigger + AFTER audit trigger (private.audit_content_change -> admin_audit_logs); this package performs ZERO content_sources writes, so neither fires
triggers_and_publication_gates.feed_items: Stage 1 migration 20261010010000 adds BEFORE-row guard trigger (trg_guard_human_feed_item_mutation) blocking ALL feed mutations unless an authorized human publish RPC sets the actor marker -- even service_role direct writes fail; this package writes zero feed rows (rehearsal enforced the same invariant with a local hard guard)
triggers_and_publication_gates.realtime_publication: no alter publication statements exist in any migration; nothing in public schema is publication-gated, so the bulk ingestion cannot interact with Realtime replication gates
triggers_and_publication_gates.impact_on_ingest: chunk inserts/updates touch only source_documents + source_snapshots; with no triggers on either table the only runtime gates are the unique indexes (idempotency) and the knowledge_citations FK RESTRICT (rollback safety)
